assumptions.text: The Moon has no atmosphere; atmospheric refraction, scattering, and twilight are strictly zero.
The Moon's reference figure is a sphere of radius 1,737,400 meters.
Ephemeris states are tabulated at uniform 3-hour intervals from JPL DE440 and interpolated with cubic Catmull-Rom splines.

South Polar terrain and slope layers are generated from a calibrated synthetic demonstration surface anchored to regional spot heights for end-to-end pipeline verification; not an ingested flight-grade LOLA DEM raster.

guided_scenarios.summary: Explores the 100% continuous solar illumination (336 hours of light) and favorable conditions along Shackleton Connecting Ridge during lunar southern summer.
guided_scenarios.title: Artemis III: Shackleton Connecting Ridge (Southern Summer)

guided_scenarios.summary: High-elevation summit offering continuous direct-to-Earth communication.
guided_scenarios.title: Malapert Massif: The Mountain of Eternal View

guided_scenarios.summary: Demonstrates the dramatic reduction in solar illumination and extended darkness (336 hours of continuous night, 0% sunlight) when launch slips into the lunar southern winter.
guided_scenarios.title: Artemis III: Southern Winter Date Slip Impact
